responsibility: Contains GCC selftests for the per-function compilation pipeline and related helpers. Rather than implementing production compiler behavior, this file builds small synthetic FUNCTION_DECLs and exercises key transitions such as function declaration construction, gimplification, CFG creation and cleanup, SSA conversion, range infrastructure setup with cfun active, and expansion from GIMPLE/SSA to RTL, then asserts on the resulting trees, CFG shape, statements, and printable RTL dumps. Its responsibility is to validate that the function-handling APIs in the middle end and RTL expansion layers produce coherent per-function state across stages.
